data.value: Ground Refueler and Hydrant Servicing Vehicle Report

data.name: label106.Text
data.value: Enter 1 for AFB when BOI "A" or "B" Authorizations are not sufficient to cover defuel requirements.

data.name: label107.Text
data.value: Enter 1 for each 600 GPM simultaneous servicing daily of primary receiver aircraft that are capable of receiving fuel from type I, type II, or type III hydrant systems at rates equal to or less than 600 GPM. Max authorized is determined by dividing the max system flow rate by 600.

data.name: label108.Text
data.value: Enter 1 for each 750 GPM simultaneous servicing daily of primary receiver aircraft that are capable of receiving fuel from a type III hydrant system at rates equal to or greater than 750 GPM. Max authorized per hydrant system is determined by dividing the max system flow rate by 750 and rounding up.
